run_download_sam3dbody_dataset: run the download script to download the facebook sam-3d-body-dataset from Hugging Face to a local directory
run_download_specific_splits: run the download script with --splits flag to download only specific dataset splits like train or test
run_download_with_workers: run the download script with --max_workers flag to control parallel download process count
review_download_file_function: review the download_file function that uses hf_hub_download to fetch a single file from a Hugging Face repo
review_multiprocess_download: review the download_files_multiprocess function that uses ProcessPoolExecutor to parallelize file downloads across multiple workers
